items.why: FAQ copy rewritten to say Product Studio Starter is free with 250 credits a week and Standard and Pro are billed monthly; no price or plan change.
Max 5x and Max 20x merged into one Max plan from $100 and a new Ultra plan at $200 was added, with Fable and API credits changes.

record.short: Max 5x and Max 20x become one Max plan at $100, and a new Ultra plan at $200 offers 10x Pro weekly usage with no 5-hour limit.
record.headline: Anthropic replaced the Max 5x and Max 20x options with a single Max plan at $100 a month (5x Pro usage) and added an Ultra plan at $200 a month with 10x Pro weekly usage and no 5-hour limit for verified accounts.
record.who: Individual Max subscribers and anyone considering the top consumer plans; Free, Pro and Team plans are unchanged in price.
record.read: The 20x option is replaced by a separately named, separately priced Ultra tier with a different limit design (weekly only), which reads as a new top rung and a way to price heavy users by weekly capacity rather than a 5-hour window. How existing Max 20x subscribers are mapped is not shown.
record.caveat: The page does not state what existing Max 20x subscribers pay or which plan they move to.

items.why: SimpleTexting and EZ Texting SMS gateways are now limited to Enterprise plans in the USA and Canada; ClickSend stays on every plan.

record.short: SimpleTexting and EZ Texting SMS gateways are now only for Enterprise plans in the USA and Canada, while ClickSend is available on every plan.

items.why: Affiliate partners teaser replaced by a Calculators banner; no pricing change.
Top banner copy changed from a Takeoff BOOST trial call to action to a generic AI tools link.

Unstable capture: both versions show the same 12-month prices, the page default switched from the 2-year plan view and ExpressAI rows were reordered; unclear whether a term was removed, so not recorded as a decided change.
Navigation menu gained a Changelog link only.
Loops, previously listed from Basic up with Not included on Free, now shows as Included on the Free plan.

record.short: Loops moves from Not included to Included on the Free plan.
record.headline: Linear now lists Loops, an agent workflow feature, as included on the Free plan, where it was previously shown as not included.
record.who: Free workspaces; paid plans already had Loops.
record.read: Opening an agent feature to the Free plan looks like a funnel move to get teams using agents earlier. This is an inference from the page layout.
record.caveat: The feature table marks Loops with asterisks, so there may be usage conditions not visible in the page text.

items.why: Start-up Plan renamed Startup plan and a GitHub counter updated; the 50% discount is unchanged.
FAQ entries explaining the Core, Advanced and Max editions were added and Flex Credits lost the per-year label; no price change shown.
Language support text expanded from 30+ to 35+ languages with a list; no price change.
Meeting preparation moved from the Premier+ feature list into the Advanced+ list on the Sugar Sell packages.

record.short: Meeting preparation moves from Premier+ ($155) into Advanced+ ($98) in the Sugar Sell package lists.

items.why: Sign-up modal and mobile notice text removed from the page; no pricing change.
Enterprise free usage promo extended from sign by 10/31 to sign by 12/31 and now reads up to 2 months.

promo.text: Enterprises get up to 2 months of usage free if they sign by 12/31 (previously 2 months, sign by 10/31)

items.why: Token FAQ answers rewritten and a billing question added; no price or allowance change.
FAQ added explaining how to estimate Sandbox costs from active resources; no price change.
A new Dispute appealed fee of CA$15.00 per appeal was added to the disputes pricing.

record.short: Stripe adds a Dispute appealed fee of CA$15.00 per dispute appeal, non-refundable even if the appeal is won.

items.why: LLM API prices repriced: Gemma 4 and GLM 5.3 rose slightly while DeepSeek V4.1 Flash fell, with the old DeepSeek rate kept as a 1017 variant.

record.short: Gemma 4 output rises ₹90.00 → ₹91.50 and GLM 5.3 output ₹390.00 → ₹396.00 per 1M tokens, while DeepSeek V4.1 Flash output falls ₹105.00 → ₹59.40.

items.why: Agent plan feature lists rewritten around campaigns and contact identification; prices unchanged and which tier holds prospecting is not clear from the page.
A 101 to 250 connections band at $48/mo each now appears where it was Contact us before.
Rotating customer testimonials changed.
Growth API credits listed as 100K instead of 300k while Core now lists 25K API credits and MCP access; Growth also adds personalized onboarding.

record.short: Growth API credits fall from 300k to 100K, while Core now includes 25K API credits and MCP access.

items.why: Enterprise changed from $2,000/month with 2,000 credits to Custom, contract pricing, contact sales.
Fly Kubernetes at $75/month per cluster is no longer listed on the pricing page.

record.short: Fly Kubernetes, previously $75/month per cluster plus compute and volumes, is no longer listed on the pricing page.

Banner changed and support response time claims reworded to an average of 21 seconds.
Header login and start buttons changed; the $99/Month plan is unchanged.
